fields.meta_title: Free Wine Quiz and Builder for Shops and Clubs | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Take a free wine quiz that matches you to crisp white, rich white, light red, or bold red. Then build one for a shop, club, bistro, or bar.
fields.h1: Build a Wine Quiz That Sends Every Guest to the Right Bottle
fields.hero_description: Build a wine quiz that matches each guest to a wine style and its bottles, or take the eight-question version below.
fields.features_heading: What Emergent Builds for a Wine Quiz
fields.features_subheading: A single prompt writes the questions, the four result screens, and the table that keeps every finish. Ask again to change any of them.
fields.feature_1:
Every option points at one wine style

Name the styles you pour or sell as results, such as crisp white or bold red. Emergent writes questions about food and drink habits, and each option maps to one of those styles.
fields.feature_2:
Bottles listed on the result screen

Tag each bottle in your catalog with one style. The result screen lists every bottle carrying that tag, with names and prices the app reads from your store through its API.
fields.feature_3:
A scored mode for staff wine tests

Switch the quiz to scored for server training. One option per question is marked correct, the app totals each score against your pass mark, and a miss shows the right answer.
fields.feature_4:
An alert the moment a quiz is finished

Send an email or a Slack message on every finish. A cellar manager learns which bottles to pack for a new member, and a trainer reads each server's score the next morning.
fields.feature_5:
A leaderboard that moves as teams answer

Run trivia night on phones, one question per screen for each team, while a live leaderboard updates on the bar's TV. No response cap applies, however full the room gets.
fields.feature_6:
Your domain, and the code on paid plans

Host the quiz on a custom domain, included in Emergent and using credits. On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository and keep each season's questions in it.
fields.why_title: Why Build Your Wine Quiz With Emergent?
fields.why_description: Each finish is a row in a database you own, with the style, the answers, and any email. Next season's buying starts there.

quiz_plan.promise: the quiz plays the page's promise: a wine quiz a visitor can take, whose results answer what the H1 says it builds

plan.angle: The top 10 splits between retailers' style finders and wine trivia pages, and none shows how to build either one. This page lets a visitor play an eight-question wine quiz that matches them to crisp white, rich white, light red, or bold red from everyday food and drink habits, then shows four wine businesses using one: an online shop that lists the bottles tagged for a result, a winery club that fills a first shipment from it, a bistro that scores servers before a new list, and a wine bar that runs trivia night on phones with a live leaderboard. Every finish lands in a database the owner keeps. The FAQ covers question writing, free use, trivia answers, scoring, result count, bottle tagging, and email capture.
tab_stories: Marrowbank Wine Shop puts the quiz on its site; Clementine Rauch's Light Red match pulls up the 3 bottles tagged Light Red, and her answers and address go into the shopper table.

New Pewter Hill Vineyards club member Lucan Ferris finishes on Crisp White, his first 6-bottle shipment is set to 4 crisp whites and 2 light reds, and cellar manager Juno Ottway gets an email naming the mix to pack.

Vesper Lane Bistro gives every server a 12-question test on the new fall list with a pass mark of 10, and Thaddeus Kimura scores 11 and pours the list on Friday while Esme Varga scores 9 and retakes it.
Corkline Wine Bar runs Thursday trivia on phones for 14 teams across 20 questions, and host Bram Esposito reads a live leaderboard that ends with Table 6 winning on 17 of 20.
